description: Single-check mutants of the BSC lifecycle driver's judge: the block checks, the shared scenario of both paths, the evidence digests, the attestation reads, the coverage and gaps, the refusals, the attestation fault, the event feeds, the crash points and the qa matrix. The portable controls in test_bsc_lifecycle.py run on the development sample.

mutants.name: block count
mutants.original: c.check("blocks.rlp holds the nine probe blocks", len(blocks) == len(BLOCK_ORDER), len(blocks))

mutants.name: genesis binding
mutants.original: c.check("genesis is the ProfileManifest genesis", report.get("genesis") == genesis_hash, report.get("genesis"))

mutants.name: block hash
mutants.original: c.check(f"{name} hash", row.get("hash") == header["hash"], (row.get("hash"), header["hash"]))

mutants.name: block parent
mutants.original: c.check(f"{name} parent", names.get(header["parent"]) == PARENTS[name], names.get(header["parent"]))

mutants.name: profile snap sync
mutants.original: ("snap_sync", "bsc.snap-sync"),

mutants.name: step error class
mutants.original: c.check(f"{where}: error class", step["class"] == klass, (step["class"], step["error"]))

mutants.name: step head
mutants.original: c.check(f"{where}: head", step["head"] == head, step["head"])

mutants.name: step open observations
mutants.original: c.check(f"{where}: no open observation", step["open_observations"] == [], step["open_observations"])

mutants.name: step view
mutants.original: c.check(f"{where}: view", step.get("view") == {"head": head, "finalized": "G"}, step.get("view"))

mutants.name: step decisions
mutants.original: c.check(f"{where}: decisions", got == list(made), got)

mutants.name: decision marker
mutants.original: d["state"] == "NATIVE_DECIDED" and d["marker"] is True

mutants.name: import evidence
mutants.original: d["evidence_digest"] == want, d["evidence_digest"])

mutants.name: canonical evidence
mutants.original: d["evidence_digest"] == canonical_evidence(caller, d["old_head"], d["new_head"]),

mutants.name: pruned parent
mutants.original: s4.get("s3_stored") is True and s4.get("s3_has_state") is False, s4)

mutants.name: paths equal
mutants.original: report["ac_cap_01_01"]["native"] == report["ac_cap_01_01"]["harness"] and

mutants.name: attestation fallback
mutants.original: ok = (e["status"] == "GENESIS_FALLBACK" and e["justified"] == genesis_head and e["finalized"] == genesis_head

mutants.name: attestation count
mutants.original: sorted(e["number"] for e in events) == sorted(d["new_head"]["number"] for d in imports),

mutants.name: gaps recomputed
mutants.original: c.check("Gaps recomputed from the coverage", gaps == report.get("gaps"), (gaps, report.get("gaps")))

mutants.name: gaps deferred only
mutants.original: c.check("the gaps are exactly the D104 rows", gaps == sorted(DEFERRED), gaps)

mutants.name: routes from the map
mutants.original: c.check("the probe's caller map is the repository map", report.get("routes") == routes, report.get("routes"))

mutants.name: outside refusals
mutants.original: c.check(f"refusal of {caller} outside the gate", isinstance(report["outside_gate_refusals"].get(caller), str),
mutants.replacement: c.check(f"refusal of {caller} outside the gate", True,

mutants.name: native extras refused
mutants.original: c.check(f"native: {name} refused", step["class"] == klass and text in (step["error"] or ""),

mutants.name: exit errors
mutants.original: c.check(f"{path}: every pass exit accepted", report[path]["exit_errors"] == [], report[path]["exit_errors"])

mutants.name: deadlock
mutants.original: c.check("deadlock smoke finished without errors", d.get("finished") is True and d.get("errors") == [], d)

mutants.name: attestation fault step
mutants.original: c.check(f"attestation fault: {name}", step["class"] == klass and step["head"] == head and

mutants.name: attestation fault head
mutants.original: c.check(f"attestation fault: {name}", step["class"] == klass and step["head"] == head and

mutants.name: decided events
mutants.original: c.check(f"events: decided {name} sends the native events (D101)", got == e["reference"].get(name),
mutants.replacement: c.check(f"events: decided {name} sends the native events (D101)", True,

mutants.name: verified event
mutants.original: got is not None and f"verified {name}" in got and f"block {name}" in got, got)

mutants.name: crash settle
mutants.original: c.check(f"crash {mode}: the lifecycle intent is {outcome}", settle == [(outcome, evidence)], settle)

mutants.name: deferred rows
matrix 06-04
mutants.original: "AC-LIF-06-04": {"bsc-private-local": "PASS" if clean else "FAIL",

mutants.name: matrix 05-02
mutants.original: "AC-LIF-05-02": {"bsc-private-local": "NOT_APPLICABLE",

mutants.name: runtime rejection
mutants.original: len(rejected) == 1 and len(intents) == 1 and rejected[0]["sequence"] == intents[0]["sequence"] and

mutants.name: guard decided
mutants.original: "open extractor obligations" in str(guard.get("decided")), guard.get("decided"))

mutants.name: guard fresh
mutants.original: guard.get("fresh") is None and guard.get("fresh_import_error") is None, guard)

mutants.name: guard pinned
mutants.original: "live pins forbid" in str(guard.get("pinned")), guard.get("pinned"))

mutants.name: malformed part
mutants.original: c.check(f"{name}: well-formed report", False, f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}")

mutants.name: canonical caller known
mutants.original: caller is not None and
mutants.equivalent: A missing caller makes canonical_evidence raise AttributeError, which the judge's part() turns into a failed well-formed-report check; the explicit guard only names the failure earlier.

mutants.name: retained absolute paths
mutants.original: require(run_directory.is_absolute() and output.is_absolute(), "Paths must be absolute")

mutants.name: retained existing output
mutants.original: require(not output.exists(), "The judge output already exists")

mutants.name: retained recorded outputs
mutants.original:
require(artifact(record["outputs"][name], 64 * 1024 * 1024) == work / name,
                f"The retained {name} is not the recorded one")
